{{< include _atlas_map.html >}}

::: {.atlas-caption}
Places analyzed with the [voting-bloc model](voting-blocs.qmd). Each of the sixteen statewide fits is colored by its precinct- or town-level voting blocs, from red (most Republican) to violet (most Democratic); points mark city and county fits; Maricopa and Pima Counties in Arizona, one joint fit around Phoenix and Tucson, are filled like a state. In California (30 blocs) and Washington (14) the colors rank each state's own blocs. Everywhere else they follow each bloc's 2020 Biden vote on one shared scale (2024 Harris vote in Maine), so neighboring blocs match across state lines. **Click any colored state or orange point** to explore its blocs. City panels rank each city's own blocs the same way, except the metro areas cut out of a statewide fit, which keep their state's colors: Seattle and San Diego (their county), Greater New Orleans (eight parishes), Greater Boston (MAPC's 101 cities and towns), and Greater Atlanta, Denver, Detroit and Charlotte (their regional councils' counties; North Carolina's only, for Charlotte). Phoenix and Tucson share one panel on the shared scale.
:::

```{=html}
<style>

                  transition: fill .15s, stroke .15s; }

.atlas-hot path.active { stroke: #222; }

                         transition: stroke .15s; }
.atlas-hot circle.city:hover, .atlas-hot circle.city:focus, .atlas-hot circle.city.active { stroke: #222; outline: none; }
.atlas-coverage { font-size: 1.1rem; margin: -.5rem 0 1rem; }
.atlas-caption { font-size: .9rem; color: #555; margin: .5rem 0 1.5rem; }
.atlas-panel { border-top: 1px solid #ddd; padding-top: 1rem; scroll-margin-top: 4rem; }
.atlas-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; }
.atlas-panel-head h2 { margin: 0; border: 0; }
.atlas-close { background: none; border: 0; font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; color: #555; }
.atlas-panel-sub { color: #555; margin: .25rem 0 1rem; }
.atlas-panel-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: start; }
.atlas-panel-grid figure { margin: 0; }
.atlas-panel-grid img { width: 100%; height: auto; }
.atlas-panel-grid figcaption { font-size: .8rem; color: #666; margin-top: .25rem; }
.atlas-blocs { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; align-self: center; }
.atlas-blocs li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr; column-gap: .6rem; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
.bloc-swatch { grid-row: span 2; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #111;
               display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; }
.bloc-name { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }
.bloc-meta { font-size: .8rem; color: #666; }
.atlas-zoom { position: relative; overflow: hidden; touch-action: none; cursor: grab; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; }
.atlas-zoom.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
.atlas-zoom-stage { position: relative; transform-origin: 0 0; will-change: transform; }
.atlas-zoom img { display: block; margin: 0; user-select: none; -webkit-user-drag: none; }
.atlas-zoom img.atlas-zoom-lines { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.atlas-zoom-labels { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; }

                          white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.8), 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }

                         font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; color: #222; padding: 0; }
.atlas-zoom-ctl button:hover { background: #fff; border-color: #222; }

.atlas-pca[role=button]:focus { outline: none; }
.atlas-pca[aria-expanded=true] img { outline: 2px solid #222; outline-offset: 2px; }
.atlas-demog { margin-top: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px dashed #ccc; padding-top: 1rem; scroll-margin-top: 4rem; }
.atlas-demog > img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.atlas-demog-keys { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
.atlas-demog-keys h3 { font-size: .75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #555; margin: 0 0 .4rem; border: 0; }
.atlas-demog-keys p, .atlas-demog-note { font-size: .8rem; color: #666; margin: .3rem 0 0; }

.atlas-ticks span { position: absolute; top: 2px; transform: translateX(-50%); white-space: nowrap; }
.atlas-ticks span:first-child { transform: none; }
.atlas-ticks span:last-child:not(:first-child) { transform: translateX(-100%); }
.atlas-race { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .15rem .8rem; font-size: .8rem; }
.atlas-race span { display: inline-block; width: .8rem; height: .8rem; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: .4rem; vertical-align: -1px; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .atlas-demog-keys { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .atlas-panel-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .atlas-state-map { order: -1; }
}
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const show = (state) => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-panel").forEach(p => p.hidden = p.id !== "panel-" + state);
    document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-hot [data-state]").forEach(p => p.classList.toggle("active", p.dataset.state === state));
    const panel = document.getElementById("panel-" + state);
    if (panel) panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-hot [data-state]").forEach(p => {
    p.addEventListener("click", () => show(p.dataset.state));
    p.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); show(p.dataset.state); } });
  });
  // clicking a panel's PCA opens, below it, the same points colored by density, race and education
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-panel").forEach(panel => {
    const fig = panel.querySelector(".atlas-pca"), demog = panel.querySelector(".atlas-demog");
    if (!fig || !demog) return;
    fig.tabIndex = 0;
    fig.setAttribute("role", "button");
    fig.setAttribute("aria-controls", demog.id);
    fig.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    const toggle = () => {
      const open = demog.hidden;
      if (open) { const img = demog.querySelector("img[data-src]"); if (img && !img.src) img.src = img.dataset.src; }
      demog.hidden = !open;
      fig.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
      if (open) demog.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    };
    fig.addEventListener("click", toggle);
    fig.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); } });
  });
  // zoomable bloc maps: wheel / pinch / double-click to zoom about the pointer, drag to pan, buttons for +, -, reset.
  // The high-resolution image is swapped in the first time a map is zoomed. Zooming in fades in the units'
  // boundaries (a transparent image laid out like the map) and then town names, kept at a fixed screen size:
  // a name shows once its town is about as wide on screen as the name (less for cities, which are small for
  // their size), most populous towns first, never overlapping each other or the zoom buttons.
  const LINES_FROM = 1.5, LINES_FULL = 4, LINES_MAX = 0.75, LABELS_FROM = 2.2;
  const measure = document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-zoom").forEach(box => {
    const img = box.querySelector("img"), MAX = 10;
    let k = 1, x = 0, y = 0;
    const stage = document.createElement("div"); stage.className = "atlas-zoom-stage";
    img.before(stage); stage.appendChild(img);
    let lines = null, labels = null, labelBox = null, queued = false;
    const ctl = document.createElement("div"); ctl.className = "atlas-zoom-ctl";
    ctl.innerHTML = '<button type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button><button type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">&minus;</button><button type="button" aria-label="Reset zoom">&#8634;</button>';
    box.appendChild(ctl);
    const loadOverlays = () => {
      if (img.dataset.lines) {
        lines = document.createElement("img"); lines.className = "atlas-zoom-lines"; lines.alt = ""; lines.draggable = false;
        lines.src = img.dataset.lines; stage.appendChild(lines); delete img.dataset.lines;
      }
      if (img.dataset.labels) {
        labelBox = document.createElement("div"); labelBox.className = "atlas-zoom-labels"; ctl.before(labelBox);
        fetch(img.dataset.labels).then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : []).then(rows => {
          const probe = labelBox.appendChild(document.createElement("span"));
          measure.font = getComputedStyle(probe).font; probe.remove();   // the labels' own font
          labels = rows.map(r => ({ ...r, tw: measure.measureText(r.n).width + 2, el: null }));
          placeLabels();
        }).catch(() => {});
        delete img.dataset.labels;
      }
    };
    const placeLabels = () => {
      queued = false;
      if (!labels) return;
      const w = img.offsetWidth, h = img.offsetHeight, bw = box.clientWidth, bh = box.clientHeight, TH = 13,
            c = ctl.getBoundingClientRect(), b0 = box.getBoundingClientRect(),
            placed = [[c.left - b0.left - 4, c.top - b0.top - 4, c.right - b0.left + 4, c.bottom - b0.top + 4]];
      for (const l of labels) {
        let show = k >= LABELS_FROM && l.w * w * k >= (l.p >= 50000 ? 0.2 : l.p >= 20000 ? 0.4 : 0.8) * l.tw;
        let left, top;
        if (show) {
          left = x + l.x * w * k - l.tw / 2; top = y + l.y * h * k - TH / 2;
          show = left > 2 && top > 2 && left + l.tw < bw - 2 && top + TH < bh - 2 &&
            !placed.some(b => left < b[2] && left + l.tw > b[0] && top < b[3] && top + TH > b[1]);
        }
        if (show) {
          placed.push([left - 3, top - 2, left + l.tw + 3, top + TH + 2]);
          if (!l.el) { l.el = document.createElement("span"); l.el.textContent = l.n; labelBox.appendChild(l.el); }
          l.el.style.transform = `translate(${left.toFixed(1)}px, ${top.toFixed(1)}px)`;
          l.el.hidden = false;
        } else if (l.el) l.el.hidden = true;
      }
    };
    const apply = () => {
      const w = img.offsetWidth, h = img.offsetHeight;
      x = Math.min(0, Math.max(w - w * k, x)); y = Math.min(0, Math.max(h - h * k, y));   // keep the map filling the frame
      stage.style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px) scale(${k})`;
      if (k > 1 && img.dataset.hi) { img.src = img.dataset.hi; delete img.dataset.hi; loadOverlays(); }
      if (lines) lines.style.opacity = LINES_MAX * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (k - LINES_FROM) / (LINES_FULL - LINES_FROM)));
      if (labels && !queued) { queued = true; requestAnimationFrame(placeLabels); }
    };
    const zoomAt = (f, px, py) => {                // px, py: point in the frame that stays put
      const k1 = Math.min(MAX, Math.max(1, k * f)); f = k1 / k;
      x = px - (px - x) * f; y = py - (py - y) * f; k = k1; apply();
    };
    const local = e => { const r = box.getBoundingClientRect(); return [e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top]; };
    const centre = () => [box.clientWidth / 2, box.clientHeight / 2];
    const [bIn, bOut, bReset] = ctl.querySelectorAll("button");
    bIn.addEventListener("click", () => zoomAt(1.6, ...centre()));
    bOut.addEventListener("click", () => zoomAt(1 / 1.6, ...centre()));
    bReset.addEventListener("click", () => { k = 1; x = 0; y = 0; apply(); });
    ctl.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => e.stopPropagation());
    ctl.addEventListener("dblclick", e => e.stopPropagation());
    box.addEventListener("wheel", e => { e.preventDefault(); zoomAt(Math.exp(-e.deltaY * (e.deltaMode ? 0.05 : 0.0025)), ...local(e)); }, { passive: false });
    box.addEventListener("dblclick", e => zoomAt(e.shiftKey ? 1 / 2 : 2, ...local(e)));
    const pts = new Map(); let last = null;
    box.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { box.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); pts.set(e.pointerId, local(e)); box.classList.add("dragging"); last = null; });
    box.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
      if (!pts.has(e.pointerId)) return;
      const prev = pts.get(e.pointerId), cur = local(e); pts.set(e.pointerId, cur);
      if (pts.size === 1) { x += cur[0] - prev[0]; y += cur[1] - prev[1]; apply(); return; }
      const [a, b] = [...pts.values()], d = Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]), m = [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2];
      if (last) { x += m[0] - last.m[0]; y += m[1] - last.m[1]; zoomAt(d / last.d, ...m); }
      last = { d, m };
    });
    const up = e => { pts.delete(e.pointerId); last = null; if (!pts.size) box.classList.remove("dragging"); };
    box.addEventListener("pointerup", up); box.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
    window.addEventListener("resize", apply);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-close").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    b.closest(".atlas-panel").hidden = true;
    document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-hot [data-state]").forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
  }));
});
</script>
```
